exposure: antenatal and postpartum Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) scores
outcome: Postpartum depression (PPD) as measured by the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS)
cohort: 738 patients with antenatal and postpartum EPDS scores
finding: While there was no difference in the incidence of PPD by mode of delivery, the incidence of PPD was higher among patients who delivered via unscheduled cesarean for non-reassuring fetal heart tones (NRFHT) compared to other indications for unscheduled cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the incidence of PPD by mode of delivery.
